consumer: The frontend status panel renderer that asks 'what pain/stamina value does the GUI show the player?' — i.e. the displayed status readout, not raw world state.
scope: The displayed/perceived view of avatar status as the engine's own status UI would format it (e.g. perceived pain after analgesia, formatted stamina), not the raw scalar.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) — it writes ctx.u.get_pain()/get_stamina() raw engine getters straight into the snapshot JSON with no display-side transform.
divergence: Avatar with high raw pain but heavily medicated (strong painkillers/analgesia): get_pain() returns the large raw value, while the engine's status panel would display a perceived/reduced pain (often 0) — the raw getter overstates what the GUI shows.
